title: Decision: keyMaterial for a did_webvh room requires the did_webvh credential type, which implies the record component (supersedes mimid-1wgh.4.81.24 in part)
description:
With the record an app_data_dictionary component (mimid-1wgh.4.81.34), a KeyPackage can join a did_webvh room only if its leaf lists the record component in app_components (mls-extensions-11 §5; the room's GroupContext app_components names it). Decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.24 had keyMaterial requests (protocol-07 §5.2) carry did_webvh_heads in extension_types and did_webvh in credential_types. The extension type no longer means anything, and protocol-07's RequiredCapabilities (RFC 9420 §11.1) has no field for components.

Readings: (a) require only the credential type and let a Commit fail on a KeyPackage without the component; (b) carry app_components in the request's extensions (mimi-protocol #190 key_material_request_extensions), not in draft-07; (c) require the credential type and take it to imply the component, since a client that lists did_webvh implements the draft and so lists the record (the spike's suggested -01 text: 'A client that lists did_webvh in the credentials field of its LeafNode capabilities MUST list did_webvh_heads in the app_components component'), checked by the target provider next to satisfies() and by the requester on what comes back.

Chosen: (c). mimid-agent-core required_capabilities: app_data_dictionary + AppDataUpdate + did_webvh credential type (no extension type). mimi_mls::didwebvh::key_package_lists_record(info, required, code_points) is true unless required lists the did_webvh credential type and the KeyPackage's leaf app_components lacks the record component (VerifiedKeyPackageInfo::app_components, new accessor). mimid-server's keyMaterial serving (follower/key_packages.rs) uses it with satisfies(); the agent skips a returned KeyPackage that fails it. INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC: the implication. A provider that does not know it may still return a KeyPackage that cannot be added; for -01 or mimi-protocol: a way to require components in keyMaterial (feedback item 26).
close_reason: Mark 2026-11-19: both. -01 rule in mls-didwebvh-credential ca10ae2; WG comment on mimi-protocol#194 drafted for review.
